summary: Still Form Parity Oracle — default product detail (sirsoft-basic) is the SSoT for option selector, additional options, reviews, Q&A, wishlist, cart/buy-now. Map below is exact, with reuse-ready contracts, evidence file:line refs, and an implementation plan skeleton per feature for templates/_bundled/superbify-commerce_minimal/.

findings.detail: 1D/2D/3D option selector: Group-wise sequential Select per option_group, with cascading disable (groupIndex > 0 disabled until previous group value set). Last group fires `sirsoft-basic.addSelectedItemIfComplete` to push a block into _local.selectedOptionItems. After completion the user can repeat to add another combination (multi-line). Data: product.data.option_groups (name_localized, values_localized) + product.data.options (one row per combination, with is_sold_out, stock_quantity, is_active, option_values_localized). Source: templates/_bundled/sirsoft-basic/layouts/shop/show.json:6-9 (computed optionChoices with soldOut detection) + layouts/partials/shop/detail/_purchase_card.json:37-109 (selector), 175-381 (selected items list, qty, price recalculation). 1D = no option_groups / options.length <= 1 → falls through to noOptionQuantity panel (_purchase_card.json:111-150). Sold-out combo: optionChoices maps label to v + ' ' + $t('shop.product.sold_out_suffix') and disabled:true (show.json:6-9).

Price recalculation: client-side using multiCurrencyPriceAdjustments map from server. Per block handler `sirsoft-basic.updateSelectedItemQuantity` / `sirsoft-basic.setBlockAdditionalOption` updates _local.selectedOptionItems[].multiCurrencyTotalPrice (per-currency map). Server still re-validates prices and stock via POST /cart → BulkAddToCartRequest + CartService::bulkAddToCart → throws CartUnavailableException (422 stock/sales), CartQuantityLimitException (422 limit). PUT /checkout also revalidates `direct_items`. No PUT /checkout on the selector side — only POST /checkout for buy-now path; PUT /checkout is reserved for temporary-order edits during the checkout flow (see api.php:221-223).

Stock/combination display: NO inline numeric stock count on detail. Stock is surfaced as (a) sold-out combo option label suffix + disabled flag in optionChoices, (b) QuantitySelector max = min(max_purchase_qty>0 ? max_purchase_qty : 999, stock_quantity) per item, (c) min/max purchase qty notices, (d) sales_status banner (sold_out / suspended / coming_soon). Numeric stock count only shown inside cart-item rows and option-change modal when count<=10 (per feature-inventory.md).

additional_options payload shape: server returns `additional_options[]` (sorted by sort_order) on PublicProductResource, each with `{id, name, is_required, values[]}` where each value has `{id, name, price_adjustment, price_adjustment_formatted, multi_currency_price_adjustment{currency:{value,formatted}}, is_default, allow_custom_text}`. Source: modules/_bundled/sirsoft-ecommerce/src/Http/Resources/PublicProductResource.php:99-129. POST /cart body: `additional_option_selections[]={additional_option_id:number, value_id:number, custom_text?:string≤255}`. Validation re-reads price from value_id (client price not trusted). Custom text shown only when `value.allow_custom_text === true`; is_required blocks submission when missing; custom_text is required when allow_custom_text+is_required (_purchase_card.json:285-326).

Reviews: source data source `reviews` (GET /api/modules/sirsoft-ecommerce/products/{code}/reviews with params page, sort (created_at_desc|rating_desc|rating_asc), photo_only, rating (1-5), option_filters (JSON-encoded map). Response shape: `{reviews:{data:[{id,user,content,rating,option_snapshot.option_values[],images[],has_reply,reply_content,replied_at,...}], meta:{current_page,last_page,per_page,has_more_pages}}, rating_stats:{avg, '1'..'5':{count,percent}}, option_filters:[{key,values:[{value,count}]}], total_count}`. UI: TabNavigation with badge=total_count (_local.activeTab hidden unless inquiry.board_slug present for qna); summary block (avg+stars+numeric, distribution bars); filter row (dynamic option filters Select per key, rating Select 1-5, photo_only toggle, sort Select); review card (Avatar + name + date, stars, option_snapshot badges, content, image grid up to 4 with +N overlay, seller reply if has_reply); Pagination composite; open review_image_modal with reviewForModal state set per click. Filters trigger setState + refetchDataSource({id:reviews}).

Reviews write: NOT inline on product detail. VERIFIED ABSENT in default template (_workspace/ecommerce-qa/feature-inventory.md REVIEW-002). Write only via mypage/orders/_modal_write_review.json (FileUploader, star picker, content, `sirsoft-ecommerce.submitReview` handler) which POSTs to /api/modules/sirsoft-ecommerce/user/reviews (permission `sirsoft-ecommerce.user-reviews.write`). Gating uses GET /user/reviews/can-write/{orderOptionId}. Member-only. Image endpoints: POST /user/reviews/{id}/images, DELETE /user/reviews/{id}/images/{image}.

Mypage reviews tab: NO reviews tab in default mypage (default mypage lists orders/profile/addresses/wishlist/coupons/mileage/inquiries/notifications only). The reviews collection lives in mypage/orders modal (write) and admin reviews admin area. Feature-inventory parity row #17 marks `Mypage reviews 탭 NO` as LOW priority.

Q&A source + gate: data source `qna` (GET /api/modules/sirsoft-ecommerce/products/{code}/inquiries, params page, per_page=10, exclude_secret). Response: `{items:[{id, title, content(?), category, is_secret, is_owner, has_reply, answered, ...}], meta:{inquiry_available:bool, board_settings:{secret_mode:disabled|optional|always, categories[], use_file_upload, max_file_count, max_file_size, allowed_extensions, min_title_length, max_title_length, min_content_length, max_content_length}, abilities:{can_update, can_reply}, total, current_page, per_page, last_page}}`. Gate: qna tab visible iff `_global.modules?.['sirsoft-ecommerce']?.inquiry?.board_slug` is truthy (show.json:265, _tab_qna.json:6). Secret-post policy: write modal shows checkbox when `secret_mode !== 'disabled'`; checkbox is disabled when `secret_mode === 'always'`; list rows where `is_secret && !is_owner && !abilities.can_update` collapse to lock-only toast on click (`shop.qna.secret_only_owner`).

Q&A APIs: list = GET /products/{code}/inquiries (public, optional auth). create = POST /products/{code}/inquiries (auth:sanctum). edit = PUT /user/inquiries/{inquiryId}. delete = DELETE /user/inquiries/{inquiryId}. seller reply = POST/PUT/DELETE /user/inquiries/{inquiryId}/reply (member-own) and admin/inquiries/{inquiryId}/reply (admin). Write modal submit branches on _global.qnaEditId: edit→PUT /user/inquiries/{id}, create→POST /products/{id}/inquiries; both reload `qna` + `myInquiries` data sources.

Wishlist heart toggle on detail: heart button in partials/shop/detail/_header.json:108-183. Guest branch: `toast` with shop.wishlist_login_required. Member branch: optimistic `setState isWishlisted=!current`, POST /api/modules/sirsoft-ecommerce/wishlist/toggle {product_id}, onSuccess syncs isWishlisted to response.data.added and refetches product DS so server-side is_wishlisted re-syncs. On error, rolls back isWishlisted to product.data.is_wishlisted. Server route `auth:sanctum` (api.php:347-356).

Wishlist list API: GET /api/modules/sirsoft-ecommerce/wishlist?page=N&per_page=20 (auth required). Delete: DELETE /wishlist/{id}. List resource returns WishlistCollection (wishlists[*].product fields = same PublicProductResource shape). Header & mypage wiring: layout `mypage/wishlist.json` already wired with DS + Pagination. Header (search/wishlist topnav) wishlist icon is in Header composite — NOT to be confused with heart on product detail (which is per-product state). Guest policy on header wishlist icon: typically redirect to login (not exercised in detail partial).

Cart POST contract: POST /api/modules/sirsoft-ecommerce/cart (BulkAddToCartRequest). Body shape A (with options): `{product_id, items:[{product_option_id, quantity, additional_option_selections:[{additional_option_id, value_id, custom_text?}]}]}`. Body shape B (no options): `{product_id, items:[{quantity}]}`. Headers: X-Cart-Key for guests (server middleware also issues/merges guest cart via POST /cart/key). Returns 201 with `{items:[CartItemResource...], cart_count}`. Client must refetch product/cart DS or rely on server-returned cart_count via state.set({cartCount}). Errors: 422 stock/quantity_limit/unavailable, 404 item not found, 500 generic. Auth: optional sanctum.

Buy-now direct checkout: POST /api/modules/sirsoft-ecommerce/checkout (CheckoutController::store). Body: either `{direct_items:[{product_id, product_option_id?, quantity, additional_option_selections?}]}` (bypasses cart) OR `{item_ids:[cart_id...]}` (uses existing cart items). Headers: X-Cart-Key (optional.sanctum). On success navigates to /shop/checkout for members, /login?redirect=/shop/checkout for guests. Server re-validates all options/additional/stock (so client-only guards are advisory).

Existing Still Form payload (already correct shape, MISSING options/additional): scm:add-to-cart CustomEvent detail = {productId, quantity, mode, productName}. addToCartHandler dispatches body `{product_id, items:[{quantity}]}` for 'add' or `{direct_items:[{product_id, quantity}]}` for 'buy'. PATCH/DELETE /cart/{id} used by cart page (storageHandlers.ts patchCartItemQuantity). To upgrade to options parity, only the event payload needs product_option_id + additional_option_selections + the handler must mirror BulkAddToCartRequest shape.

Reuse as-is: TabNavigation, Pagination, Avatar, QuantitySelector, Icon, Button, Input, Select, Modal, ConfirmDialog, Toast (sirsoft-basic composites) — all share same composite registry as Still Form uses today. Server APIs are 100% reusable (sirsoft-ecommerce module is on the same route prefix /api/modules/sirsoft-ecommerce and ships 1.1.2). Reuse target list for Still Form: partials _purchase_card.json (full) + _tab_reviews.json + _tab_qna.json + _modal_qna_write.json + _modal_qna_reply.json + _modal_inquiry_delete.json + _modal_review_image.json + _modal_cart_added.json + _modal_login_required.json + _header.json (heart button) + sirsoft-basic handlers (addSelectedItemIfComplete / updateSelectedItemQuantity / setBlockAdditionalOption / updateNoOptionQuantity / removeSelectedItem). What must be re-skinned: tokens (scm tokens), spacing/radius/fonts, eyebrow labels, and DS layout nodes.

What Still Form currently lacks (parity-matrix.md #1/#2/#13/#14/#15/#17): option_groups / options / additional_options rendering, wishlist heart on detail, reviews tab on detail, qna tab on detail, qna write modal, mypage reviews tab. AddToCartPanel currently emits only {productId, quantity, mode} — no product_option_id or additional_option_selections, so cart receives a server-default single item. This is the regression root cause.

DS gate used by TabNavigation: TabNavigation's hiddenTabIds prop receives `{{_global.modules?.['sirsoft-ecommerce']?.inquiry?.board_slug ? [] : ['qna']}}` (show.json:265). My-Inquiries tab uses 404 fallback when meta.inquiry_available===false (mypage/inquiries.json). Cart modal `cart_added_modal` opened from add-to-cart success. Wishlist `product.data.is_wishlisted` is the source-of-truth server field that powers heart initial state.

recommendations: Feature 1 — Option selector + selected items list (OPT-001 + OPT-002). Files: layouts/partials/shop/detail/_scm_option_selector.json (new); partials/shop/detail/_scm_selected_items.json (new). Bind in layouts/shop/product.json via `partial` include after `shop_product_addtocart`. Mirror default _purchase_card.json:37-381, re-skin with scm tokens (display:flex, gap var(--scm-spacing-md), 1px solid var(--scm-line), radius var(--scm-radius-sm)). Use the SAME `sirsoft-basic.*` handlers (addSelectedItemIfComplete / setBlockAdditionalOption / updateSelectedItemQuantity / removeSelectedItem / updateNoOptionQuantity) — they are pure JS, not template-styled. `optionChoices` computed moves into product.json:computed block with same shape but referencing scm labels (still option/option/sold_out translation keys). Layout nodes: Div container with space-y-md, per-group Div with Label+Select, per-block Div with optional-group selects and quantity + line-through / total. Wrap selector in `if {{product.data?.sales_status === 'on_sale' && product.data?.has_options && product.data?.option_groups?.length > 0 && (product.data?.options?.length ?? 0) > 1}}` exactly like default. Endpoints reused: GET /api/modules/sirsoft-ecommerce/products/{slug}. Validation re-checked server-side. Props/events on AddToCartPanel: emit `{productId, items:[{product_option_id, quantity, additional_option_selections}], mode}` instead of single product_id+qty. Update scmBindAddToCartListener and addToCartHandler to map to BulkAddToCartRequest shape. Buy-now path swaps items[] to direct_items[] in /checkout body. Out of scope: 1D / no-options branch is already covered by existing AddToCartPanel min/max quantity — leave untouched (D1 only changes the >1 options path).

Feature 2 — Additional options + custom text (OPT-002). Files: same _scm_option_selector.json. Re-skin Select with var(--scm-surface)/var(--scm-line); price-adjustment inline label as `name + ' (+₩N)'` (or use _local.preferredCurrency map mirroring _purchase_card.json:267). Custom text Input appears only when `selected additional value.allow_custom_text === true`, with maxLength=255 placeholder '직접 입력'. is_required marker `*` styled in red. Validation is already server-enforced — client guards mirror default exactly. End-of-block integration: stillForm is the option-set chosen (item.product_option_id). Block key `additionalOptionSelections[additionalOptionId] = valueId` and `additionalOptionCustomTexts[additionalOptionId] = text`. The state shape carried into scm:add-to-cart detail stays a single object — see Feature 1 detail.

Feature 3 — Reviews tab on product detail (REVIEW-001 + REVIEW-003 visibility). Files: layouts/partials/shop/detail/_scm_tab_reviews.json (new). Reference: _tab_reviews.json (sirsoft-basic) line-for-line. Re-skin summary block (avg numeral + 5 stars + distribution bars), filter row (option filter Selects iteration, rating Select 5-1, photo_only pill, sort Select, reset button), review card (Avatar + name + date, 5 stars, option_snapshot badge row, content, image grid max 4 with +N overlay, seller reply if has_reply), Pagination composite, no-reviews empty state. Bind data_source `product_reviews` (already declared in product.json:21-26; ensure id parity). State shape: _local.reviewsPage (init 1), reviewSortBy (created_at_desc), reviewPhotoOnly (false), reviewRating (""), reviewOptionFilters ({}), starList=[1..5], starNums=[5,4,3,2,1]. Endpoint: GET /api/modules/sirsoft-ecommerce/products/{slug}/reviews?page=&sort=&photo_only=&rating=&option_filters= (JSON-encoded). refetchDataSource(id=product_reviews) on filter change. Tabs: extend existing scm TabNavigation (or build minimal scm tab set since sirsoft-basic TabNavigation may have visual mismatch with scm tokens — verify before reusing). Hide/conditional is NOT required for reviews; reviews tab is always visible.

Feature 4 — Q&A tab on product detail + write modal (QNA-001). Files: layouts/partials/shop/detail/_scm_tab_qna.json + _scm_modal_qna_write.json + _scm_modal_qna_reply.json + _scm_modal_inquiry_delete.json (new). Reference: _tab_qna.json, _modal_qna_write.json, _modal_qna_reply.json, _modal_inquiry_delete.json (sirsoft-basic). Re-skin table rows, secret-mode lock icon, my-inquiry badge, category badge, status column (답변대기/답변완료). Bind data_source `product_qna` (new): endpoint GET /api/modules/sirsoft-ecommerce/products/{slug}/inquiries with params page, per_page=10, exclude_secret. Response shape documented above. Tab visibility gate: `if {{!!_global.modules?.['sirsoft-ecommerce']?.inquiry?.board_slug}}` on the tab. Write button: member-only — guest branch emits `toast shop.qna.login_required`, member branch opens modal. Modal fields: is_secret (checkbox disabled when board_settings.secret_mode==='always'), category (Select from board_settings.categories), title (Input), content (Textarea). Submit branches on _global.qnaEditId: PUT /user/inquiries/{id} (edit) or POST /products/{id}/inquiries (create). On success: closeModal + refetch qna + (for create) refetch myInquiries + toast. Review/reply modal: default _modal_qna_reply.json implements the same pattern (admin reply editing).

Feature 5 — Wishlist heart on product detail (WISH-001). Files: extend layouts/shop/product.json header block (between shop_product_kv and shop_product_addtocart). Re-skin Button + Icon (heart solid/regular) with scm tokens. Wire exactly like default _header.json:108-183 — guest branch: toast shop.wishlist_login_required. member branch: optimistic setState {isWishlisted, wishlistLoading} → POST /api/modules/sirsoft-ecommerce/wishlist/toggle {product_id} → onSuccess: isWishlisted=response.data.added + refetchDataSource(product_detail) + toast → onError: roll back isWishlisted to product.data.is_wishlisted. Also extend Header.tsx (stillForm StoreHeader) — topnav heart icon should navigate to /mypage/wishlist for members and redirect to /login?redirect=/mypage/wishlist for guests. Mypage/wishlist.json already exists with the correct endpoint GET /wishlist?page=; just verify pagination component swap is correct (already done per fork_source_comment). No DELETE call on detail — toggle endpoint is idempotent (returns added:true|false). DELETE /wishlist/{id} reserved for mypage list rows.

Feature 6 — Cart/Buy-now payload upgrade (CART-001 + checkout buy-now). Files: src/components/AddToCartPanel.tsx, src/handlers/storageHandlers.ts. Change AddToCartPanel event detail to include `{productId, items, mode, productName}`. `items` is built from _local.selectedOptionItems: each item = `{product_option_id: item.optionId, quantity: clamped(item.quantity), additional_option_selections: Object.entries(item.additionalOptionSelections ?? {}).filter(([,v]) => v != null).map(([gid, vid]) => ({additional_option_id: Number(gid), value_id: Number(vid), custom_text: item.additionalOptionCustomTexts?.[Number(gid)]}))}`. scmBindAddToCartListener stays as the single window event sink. addToCartHandler (storageHandlers.ts:108-200) updates: 'add' branch → POST /api/modules/sirsoft-ecommerce/cart with `{product_id, items}` matching BulkAddToCartRequest shape. 'buy' branch → POST /api/modules/sirsoft-ecommerce/checkout with `{direct_items:[{product_id, product_option_id?, quantity, additional_option_selections?}]}`. For 'no options' stillForm path (1D), `items` collapses to `[{quantity}]` — same shape the server accepts when product_option_id is omitted. Errors: server returns 422 with `errors.message` for stock/quantity_limit/unavailable; surface via showToast('error', errBody.errors.message ?? errBody.message ?? HTTP status). Do NOT trust client prices — server re-evaluates. After success: existing handlers already update _global.cartCount via response.data.cart_count. For buy-now success → window.location.assign('/checkout') (or /login?redirect=/checkout for guests — mirror default branch).

Feature 7 — Mypage reviews tab (LOW priority, parity-matrix row #17). Files: layouts/mypage/reviews.json (new). Add as 8th tab in mypage/_tab_navigation.json (still form already has 7 tabs + change_password). Data source: GET /api/modules/sirsoft-ecommerce/user/orders with per_page=20 then client-side filter to items[].can_write_review==true (write path) and items[].has_my_review (read path). Use existing _modal_write_review.json (sirsoft-basic) for write flow (star picker + content + FileUploader + sirsoft-ecommerce.submitReview handler) — re-skin with scm tokens. Star + read-only display when item.has_my_review==true. NOTE: parity-matrix.md marks this as LOW. User approval before implementing this tab.

Common scaffolding — partial include + tab state (all features). product.json init_actions: seed _local with `selectedOptionItems: []`, `currentSelection: {}`, `noOptionQuantity: 1`, `additionalOptions: {}`, `wishlistLoading: false`, `isOrdering: false`, `activeTab: 'info'`, plus reviews/qna state shapes above. product.json computed.optionChoices: copy from default show.json:6-9 with scm sold-out label fallback. `optionChoices` is a map of groupIndex → array of {value, label, disabled} with sold-out suffix detection by intersecting remaining unselected groups against (is_sold_out || stock<=0 || !is_active). product.json data_sources: keep existing product_detail, product_reviews, related_products. ADD `product_qna` (GET /products/{slug}/inquiries) and `productDownloadableCoupons` (optional, default uses it for member coupons). All new partials emit through scm:add-to-cart CustomEvent (already bound by scmBindAddToCartListener); do not duplicate the listener.

Acceptance signal per feature (mirrors parity-matrix.md rows 1,2,13,14,15). OPT-001/002: 2D option product → fill 1st group, see 2nd group enable, pick sold-out value → see suffix + disabled + grayed select, finish block → block appears with quantity stepper + price, repeat for 2nd combination, total = sum of both. Add-to-cart posts items[] of length 2 with product_option_id and additional_option_selections. 422 from server surfaces as toast. WISH-001: guest click heart → login_required toast. Member click → heart turns red, network POST /wishlist/toggle, refresh product_detail preserves red. Refresh page → heart still red. REVIEW-001: select rating 5 → list refreshes, count badge updates, sort by rating_high reorders, photo_only toggle filters, pagination advances. QNA-001: as guest click write → login_required toast. As member click write → modal opens, secret checkbox shown when secret_mode!=='disabled'. Submit POST /products/{id}/inquiries, list reloads with new row at top. is_secret rows collapse to lock-only toast unless owner. CART/BUY-NOW: buy-now with selected option → /checkout shows that exact option on line item. Server-side stock check returns 422 if combo is now sold-out → toast.
blockersFound: No default review-write partial exists on product detail (_tab_reviews.json is read-only). VERIFIED ABSENT. Write path is exclusively mypage/orders/_modal_write_review.json — runtime-verified in _workspace/ecommerce-qa/feature-inventory.md REVIEW-002. If user wants inline write on detail, requires USER APPROVAL (new partial outside existing sirsoft-basic surface).

Default Template doesn't ship a 'Mypage reviews tab' (parity-matrix.md row #17 marks LOW). To add it stillForm needs to either fork layouts/mypage or compose inside existing mypage. USER APPROVAL required.

sirsoft-basic handlers (`sirsoft-basic.addSelectedItemIfComplete`, etc.) are registered in sirsoft-basic template's handlers/index.ts. They are pure JS and consume data passed in JSON params (no template-specific styling). Reusing them in stillForm is safe but requires that stillForm's product.json keep the same `{{product.data?.option_groups}}` / `{{product.data?.options}}` / `{{product.data?.additional_options}}` shape (already correct from PublicProductResource).

All three module-version numbers reported by user (G7 7.0.8 + sirsoft-ecommerce 1.1.2) align with what the layouts/handlers consume, but the stillForm product.json fork_source_comment claims derivation from sirsoft-basic v1.0.0 — no spec/version drift visible.
